brief_jobs_status.name: brief_jobs_status
brief_jobs_status.value:
"brief_jobs"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'ready', 'failed')
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'running') = ("brief_jobs"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "brief_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'ready') = ("brief_jobs"."candidates" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'failed') = ("brief_jobs"."failure" IS NOT NULL)

comments_subject.name: comments_subject
comments_subject.value:
(
      ("comments"."subject_kind" = 'project' AND "comments"."subject_id" = "comments"."project_id" AND "comments"."work_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("comments"."subject_kind" = 'task' AND "comments"."work_id" IS NOT NULL AND "comments"."work_id" = "comments"."subject_id")
      OR ("comments"."subject_kind" IN ('document', 'meeting') AND "comments"."work_id" IS NULL)
    )

comments_content.name: comments_content
comments_content.value:
char_length(btrim("comments"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000
      AND cardinality("comments"."mention_ids") <= 20 AND "comments"."version" > 0

comments_resolution.name: comments_resolution
comments_resolution.value:
("comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "comments"."resolved_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("comments"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "comments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "comments"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL)

connector_installations_provider.name: connector_installations_provider
connector_installations_provider.value:
("connector_installations"."provider" = 'fixture' AND "connector_installations"."github_installation" IS NULL AND "connector_installations"."google_subject" IS NULL)
        OR ("connector_installations"."provider" = 'github' AND "connector_installations"."github_installation" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,15}$' AND "connector_installations"."github_installation" IS NOT NULL AND "connector_installations"."google_subject" IS NULL)
        OR ("connector_installations"."provider" IN ('calendar','gmail') AND "connector_installations"."github_installation" IS NULL AND "connector_installations"."google_subject" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$' AND "connector_installations"."google_subject" IS NOT NULL)

connector_jobs_kind.name: connector_jobs_kind
connector_jobs_kind.value:
("connector_jobs"."kind" = 'cleanup' OR "connector_jobs"."mapping_id" IS NOT NULL)
      AND "connector_jobs"."kind" IN ('sync','delivery','cleanup','outbound')

connector_shares_retention_idx.name: connector_shares_retention_idx
connector_shares_retention_idx.where: "connector_shares"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "connector_shares"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

decisions_one_successor_idx.name: decisions_one_successor_idx
decisions_one_successor_idx.where: confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_id IS NOT NULL

inbox_entries_email_idx.name: inbox_entries_email_idx
inbox_entries_email_idx.where: "inbox_entries"."email_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inbox_entries"."email_result" IS NULL

meetings_calendar_source_state.name: meetings_calendar_source_state
meetings_calendar_source_state.value:
("meetings"."calendar_source_id" IS NULL AND "meetings"."calendar_revision" IS NULL AND NOT "meetings"."calendar_canceled")
      OR ("meetings"."calendar_source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "meetings"."calendar_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "meetings"."calendar_revision" > 0)

meetings_state.name: meetings_state
meetings_state.value:
"meetings"."status" IN ('empty','queued','processing','ready','failed')
    AND "meetings"."attempt" BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND "meetings"."retention_days" IN (7,30,90)
    AND ("meetings"."status" = 'processing') = ("meetings"."lease" IS NOT NULL AND "meetings"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)

source_revisions_retention_idx.name: source_revisions_retention_idx
source_revisions_retention_idx.where: "source_revisions"."purged_at" IS NULL AND "source_revisions"."title" IS NOT NULL

work_items_deadline_idx.name: work_items_deadline_idx
work_items_deadline_idx.where: "work_items"."archived_at" IS NULL AND "work_items"."status" <> 'done' AND coalesce("work_items"."deadline", "work_items"."commitment") IS NOT NULL

work_items_blocker.name: work_items_blocker
work_items_blocker.value:
"work_items"."blocker_reason" IS NOT NULL OR
    ("work_items"."blocker_owner_id" IS NULL AND "work_items"."blocker_resolution" IS NULL)

workspace_retention_days.name: workspace_retention_days
workspace_retention_days.value:
"workspace_retention"."audio_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND "workspace_retention"."transcript_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650
      AND "workspace_retention"."imported_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650 AND "workspace_retention"."log_days" BETWEEN 1 AND 365
